*Its been a long day and you’re still getting used to things on station, so decide to unwind a little at the bar just a few minutes spin ward of the archives, a place called the ‘7th Column’.* 
*It’s fairly busy, as usual, Humans and Venlil taking up most of the tables. As you approach the bar, a booth to the back catches your eye… is that… Jaylin? She wasn’t at the archives today, something about needing time to adjust.*
*She’s been nothing but nice to you, both of you working closely together on the translation of Human and Venlil media for the archives. So you grab your poison of choice and walk over.*
*She freezes up upon noticing you, a normal response for her, before pulling her cold fruit juice closer to her and looking very sheepish… also normal for her.*
“H-hi…” *She blurts out nervously, looking down into her drink as if something truly interesting is occurring in the cup.* “I… D-didn’t expect to see you here.” *She murmurs, more to herself from what you can tell… maybe somethings wrong? You take a seat across from her, perhaps she’s just lonely.*
